Stock market news | NSE $64.1 billion market cap makes third-largest exchange

NSE's market capitalisation reached $64.1 billion, placing it ahead of Deutsche Boerse, London Stock Exchange Group and Nasdaq, making it the world's third-largest listed exchange. The rise strengthens NSE's global standing, moving ahead of two major European bourses after a sharp share price increase.
